def test_user_register_and_login():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"
    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    user_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert user_id == username, "Expected returned id to match username"

    resp_get = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{user_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp_get.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_get.status_code}: {resp_get.text}"
    assert "password" not in resp_get.text, "Password should not be returned"

    resp_login = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp_login.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_login.status_code}: {resp_login.text}"

def test_user_add_address_and_card():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "pwd",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)

    address_data = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "W1 1AA",
        "street": "Baker St",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp_addr = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp_addr.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_addr.status_code}: {resp_addr.text}"
    addr_id = resp_addr.json().get("id")
    assert addr_id is not None, "Expected address id in response"

    resp_addr_get = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{addr_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp_addr_get.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_addr_get.status_code}: {resp_addr_get.text}"
    assert resp_addr_get.json().get("city") == "London", "Expected city to match"

    card_data = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp_card = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp_card.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_card.status_code}: {resp_card.text}"
    card_id = resp_card.json().get("id")
    assert card_id is not None, "Expected card id in response"

    resp_card_get = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp_card_get.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_card_get.status_code}: {resp_card_get.text}"
    assert "1234567890123456" not in resp_card_get.text, "Raw card number should not be returned"

def test_carts_add_item_and_delete():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    item_id = f"item_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    item_data = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": 15.5
    }

    resp_add = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp_add.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp_add.status_code}: {resp_add.text}"

    resp_get = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp_get.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_get.status_code}: {resp_get.text}"
    items = resp_get.json()
    assert any(i.get("itemId") == item_id for i in items), "Expected item in cart"

    resp_del = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp_del.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp_del.status_code}: {resp_del.text}"

    resp_get_del = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp_get_del.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp_get_del.status_code}: {resp_get_del.text}"

def test_orders_create_and_search():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json={"username": username, "password": "pwd", "email": f"{username}@example.com", "firstName": "F", "lastName": "L"}, timeout=10)

    resp_addr = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json={"city": "C", "country": "C", "number": "1", "postcode": "1", "street": "S", "userID": username}, timeout=10)
    addr_id = resp_addr.json().get("id")

    resp_card = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json={"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456", "userID": username}, timeout=10)
    card_id = resp_card.json().get("id")

    item_id = "3395a43e-2d88-40de-b95f-e00e1502085b"
    resp_cat = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    if resp_cat.status_code == 200 and len(resp_cat.json()) > 0:
        item_id = resp_cat.json()[0].get("id")

    requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json={"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 10.0}, timeout=10)

    order_req = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{addr_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp_order = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp_order.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp_order.status_code}: {resp_order.text}"
    order_id = resp_order.json().get("id")
    assert order_id is not None, "Expected order id in response"
    assert resp_order.json().get("payment", {}).get("authorised") is True, "Expected payment to be authorised"

    resp_order_get = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp_order_get.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_order_get.status_code}: {resp_order_get.text}"
    assert resp_order_get.json().get("id") == order_id, "Expected order id to match"

    resp_search = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp_search.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_search.status_code}: {resp_search.text}"
    orders = resp_search.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert any(o.get("id") == order_id for o in orders), "Expected order in search results"

def test_payment_authorize():
    order_id = f"order_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    payment_req = {
        "address": {"city": "C", "country": "C", "number": "1", "postcode": "1", "street": "S"},
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456"},
        "customer": {"firstName": "F", "lastName": "L"},
        "orderId": order_id
    }

    resp_pay = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp_pay.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_pay.status_code}: {resp_pay.text}"
    assert resp_pay.json().get("authorised") is True, "Expected payment to be authorised"

    resp_get = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp_get.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_get.status_code}: {resp_get.text}"
    auths = resp_get.json()
    assert isinstance(auths, list) and len(auths) > 0, "Expected authorizations list"
    assert auths[0].get("orderId") == order_id, "Expected orderId to match"
